Subject: Post-call: buying lanes, owners, and contract queue

Hi Rachel / Tom — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same map: 

Call recap (30m):
- Use case: clinical chart summarization + distributed audit logs for research access.
- Primary objectives: improve clinician throughput; preserve PHI controls and retention policy.
- Decision criteria: accuracy on clinical prompts, latency < 300ms p50, and contract terms for data residency & auditability.

Ask / next steps:
1) Stakeholder roster: can you confirm economic owner + security/legal + procurement point people and their preferred review order? (we sketched a couple during the call but want the authoritative list)
2) Legal sequencing: do you prefer we sign a mutual NDA first, or should we start with an MSA/DPA draft concurrently?
3) Timeline: target decision window you shared looked like mid-May — can you confirm gating steps and any blackout dates for legal review this month?
4) Docs: attaching our NDA template and a short MSA excerpt with common redline flags so your legal team has something to react to quickly.

Attachments: Redwood_NDA_template.pdf (attached) — happy to slot in your preferred NDA instead.

I'll coordinate internal owners for redlines once we get your stakeholder list and preference on NDA vs MSA first.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
